releaseNotes: MedDef client for ONNX imaging and optional text inference against your configured API.

ios.notes: iOS builds are distributed via TestFlight or the App Store. Direct IPA downloads are not offered here for signing and provisioning reasons.

macos.notes: macOS desktop build will be published when CI produces a signed .dmg or .app.zip.

windows.notes: Windows installer will be published when CI produces an .exe or MSIX package.

linux.notes: Linux is not available for download yet. Use Android, iOS, macOS, or Windows builds below, or check back later.
